sourceRefs.locator: Latin palaeography, Lesson One, E 31/1/3, folios 311v–312, text lines 1–11 and English translation. Land, burgesses, men described as French and the gift of 60,000 herrings.
Location, map and History. The later friary stood at the western edge of the medieval town. The Domesday section gives 236 burgesses and the land already lost to coastal erosion.
